name: manual_a655f8
claim: When a code review suggests a specific diff for a fix, verify the suggested diff itself against actual behavior before applying it verbatim -- a suggestion can be directionally correct about the bug while its own literal proposed fix has a separate latent bug or an unstated behavioral regression. Two independent failure modes to check for: (1) a string-manipulation fix that looks right but breaks on an edge case the review didn't consider (e.g. using an already-transformed value as a prefix to strip from the original, which only works if the transformation was a no-op), and (2) a fix that removes an implicit default/fallback the existing code relied on, silently changing behavior for every caller that depended on the untouched default.

decisions.notes: Two concrete instances of verifying a review's own suggested fix before applying it, one session, one review pass.

rationale: Two concrete instances of verifying a review's own suggested fix before applying it, one session, one review pass.
